items.question: What quantity of insertion is accepted for a five-faced receptacle in certain cases?
premises: A five-faced receptacle is the context under consideration.
Four portions together may be inserted in that context.
Alternatively the entire amount may be inserted in that context.
This arrangement is regarded as accepted in some cases.
items.inference: Therefore a five-faced receptacle admits either four portions together or the entire amount as a valid option.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the inserted material depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: In a five-faced one, inserting four together or the whole amount is, in some cases, considered acceptable.
